title: The Singular Values of Lévy's Area Matrix
summary: The matrix of Lévy's areas of $d$-dimensional Brownian motion is a fundamental object in stochastic analysis. In this article, we study the singular values of this $d \times d$ skew-symmetric random matrix. First, we derive an explicit formula for the density of the singular values and, en passant, present a new short proof of the characteristic function of Lévy's area when $d \ge 3$. This also allows us to extend the well-known formula for the density of Lévy's area to $d \ge 3$.
